metadata.name: mousetrap_vault
metadata.description: MouseTrap maker-rebate vault: escrow, draw gate, attested NAV

docs: Maker-rebate vault escrow. See AGENTS.md sections 4 and 5.

accounts.name: gemini_destination
docs: Gate 7: the only account a draw can pay.

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

errors.name: InvalidParams
errors.msg: Invalid vault parameters

errors.name: InvalidAttestors
errors.msg: Invalid attestor set or quorum

errors.name: InvalidMint
errors.msg: USDC mint must have 6 decimals

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Signer does not hold the required role

errors.name: Paused
errors.msg: Vault is paused

errors.name: DepositCapExceeded
errors.msg: Deposit would exceed the vault's TVL cap

errors.name: EpochNotSettled
errors.msg: Ticket belongs to an epoch that has not settled

errors.name: InsufficientIdle
errors.msg: Idle USDC cannot cover this claim yet

errors.name: GateBondCoverage
errors.msg: Gate 1: operator bond does not cover outstanding principal

errors.name: GateAbsoluteCap
errors.msg: Gate 2: outstanding principal would exceed the absolute cap

errors.name: GateNavShare
errors.msg: Gate 3: outstanding principal would exceed the allowed share of NAV

errors.name: GateIdleBuffer
errors.msg: Gate 4: idle buffer would fall below the minimum or queued withdrawals

errors.name: GateNavStale
errors.msg: Gate 5: no fresh quorum-signed NAV report

errors.name: GateHealth
errors.msg: Gate 6: attested Gemini equity is below the health threshold

errors.name: GateRecallOpen
errors.msg: Gate 8: a recall is open

errors.name: GatePerDrawLimit
errors.msg: Gate 8: draw exceeds the per-draw limit

errors.name: BondLocked
errors.msg: Bond is locked behind outstanding draws or an open recall

errors.name: NavReplay
errors.msg: NAV report timestamp is not newer than the last report

errors.name: NavFromFuture
errors.msg: NAV report timestamp is in the future

errors.name: NavTooOld
errors.msg: NAV report is too old

errors.name: QuorumNotMet
errors.msg: Not enough attestor signatures for quorum

errors.name: MalformedSignature
errors.msg: Malformed ed25519 instruction

errors.name: EpochTooSoon
errors.msg: Epoch cannot settle yet

errors.name: NavRequired
errors.msg: A fresh NAV report is required before settling

errors.name: ConditionNotMet
errors.msg: Breaker condition does not hold

errors.name: NothingDrawn
errors.msg: Nothing is drawn

errors.name: NoFees
errors.msg: No fees owed

fields.name: assets
docs: NAV and shares at settlement, after fees: the price every ticket of this epoch uses.

fields.name: bond_min_bps
docs: Gate 1: bond must cover this share of outstanding principal.

fields.name: absolute_cap
docs: Gate 2: hard cap on outstanding principal, in USDC base units.

fields.name: drawn_nav_max_bps
docs: Gate 3: outstanding principal as a share of NAV.

fields.name: buffer_bps
docs: Gate 4: idle USDC kept back as a share of NAV.

fields.name: health_min_bps
docs: Gate 6: attested equity over outstanding principal needed to draw.

fields.name: recall_health_bps
docs: Below this, a NAV report slashes the bond and opens a full recall.

fields.name: per_draw_bps
docs: Gate 8: largest single draw as a share of `absolute_cap`.

fields.name: nav_max_age_secs
docs: Gate 5: oldest NAV report a draw or settlement accepts.

fields.name: nav_silence_secs
docs: With principal drawn and no report for this long, anyone can open a recall.

fields.name: performance_fee_bps
docs: Taken above the share price high-water mark at each settlement.

fields.name: deposit_cap
docs: Cap on NAV plus pending deposits. Zero means no cap.

types.name: VaultSettings
docs: Roles, destination and limits. Fixed at initialisation; no instruction changes them.

fields.name: gemini_destination
docs: USDC token account of the operator's Gemini deposit address.

fields.name: total_shares
docs: Shares outstanding, including settled deposits not yet claimed and fee shares owed.

fields.name: gemini_equity
docs: Last attested equity, adjusted for draws and repayments since.

fields.name: nav_at
docs: Signed timestamp of the last accepted NAV report.

fields.name: pending_deposits
docs: USDC deposited this epoch, waiting for the epoch price.

fields.name: pending_withdraw_shares
docs: Shares burned for withdrawal this epoch, still counted in `total_shares`.

fields.name: reserved_withdrawals
docs: USDC owed to settled withdrawal tickets.

constants.name: NAV_DOMAIN
docs: Prefix of the message attestors sign for a NAV report.
